summary_en: This study tests a staged sequence of chemotherapy drugs in patients with metastatic Ewing sarcoma that has spread widely. Treatment is given in stages over weeks 1 to 38, followed by a maintenance phase of alternating 28-day blocks planned through week 104. Some stages use IV drugs, some use oral drugs, and one stage includes radiation to the primary site; this is a Phase 1 study, the main outcome is not stated, and the record says it is designed to show feasibility.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba una secuencia por etapas de medicamentos de quimioterapia en pacientes con sarcoma de Ewing metastásico que se ha diseminado ampliamente. El tratamiento se administra en etapas durante las semanas 1 a 38, seguido de una fase de mantenimiento con bloques alternos de 28 días planificados hasta la semana 104. Algunas etapas usan medicamentos intravenosos, otras usan medicamentos orales, y una etapa incluye radiación al sitio primario; este es un estudio de Fase 1, el resultado principal no está indicado y el registro señala que está diseñado para demostrar la viabilidad.
who_for: Age over 1 year, with no upper age limit
New diagnosis of widely metastatic Ewing sarcoma or metastatic CIC-rearranged sarcoma
Enough tumor tissue available for correlative testing
No prior systemic therapy, except possibly one cycle of VDC started before enrollment
Healthy enough to tolerate protocol therapy, in the investigator's opinion
not_for: Localized disease, or lung-only metastases in Ewing sarcoma
Central nervous system tumors, primary or metastatic
Currently receiving other investigational agents for the cancer
Prior cancer treated with myelosuppressive chemotherapy or radiation
Pregnant or breast-feeding, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness
